submitted.rationale: Of the 3 merit measurements, 175 (Fe0.61 Ni0.22 V0.18) gave the highest photocurrent: 7.7e-7 A. The next best were 49 (7.0e-7 A) and 144 (4.1e-7 A). Photocurrent rose with Fe content. XRD of the Fe-rich films (49, and the Ni-rich 25) showed simple two-peak patterns. The Fe/V~1 film (144) and V-rich film (12) showed patterns with several phases, and 144 performed worse. Among Fe-rich films, a little more V (175) did slightly better than 49.

rejected.reason: Measured 4.1e-7 A; FeVO4-like mixed-phase region performs worse than Fe-rich films
Not measured for merit. Merit budget went to the Fe-rich trend; XRD shows these films are mixed-phase (V-rich) or a different simple phase (Ni-rich)
